notes.title: Episode 2 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hotfix notes:

 Fixed scenes looping back to PvP / Raids section, preventing progression in the story.


Small fixes:

 Corrected some character faces that were displaying incorrectly in the dialogue box.
 Added missing animation to Scene 63.



Thank you for reporting the issue that caused the game to loop! Scenes should now progress properly all the way to the Episode 2 credits. I hope you can jump back in and finish the episode, and I apologize if this affected your immersion too much.

notes.title: EPISODE 2 IS OUT!
notes.content:
That's it, it's out, you can play it.

This episode features more interaction with the characters than the first one, as well as new animations and music.

Everyone was asking, we had this one guy that every day would knock on the office window and ask "When is episode 2 coming out?" So here it is, it's out! We can remove the window now!

If you have already bought convento but haven't played yet, this is a good opportunity to do it and tell us what you liked about it! Or else we might release Convento Remastered GOTY edition without you having played the original! 


FAQ.

 What is it?
It's more game, a continuation of the first episode
Can I eat it?
No, it's just more game, there's no food.
Does it contain new missions and raids with monsters to kill?
No, it's still a visual novel, not a shooter or an action game.
I'm rich, very rich, and I noticed convento is still priced fairly low, will the price go up as more episodes are released?
This is not financial advice, but we are considering changing the price when the full game releases, consider this a reward for believing in us so that one day you will proudly tell your friends "I played Convento when it was Hot, now it's dead, it's literally over"

notes.title: Convento wants YOU - to write a review!
notes.content:
Road to 50 reviews

We're at 3, which is better than 2.

Everybody asks, what can Convento do for me? Today I ask what can you do for Convento? Well it's pretty simple, write a review!

Launching the game and seeing how each person clicked with the story (or not) in their own way has been exciting. All feedback has been a huge help, technical, story, aesthetic and so on!

If you want to support Convento just follow this quick guide: 
[olist]
 Get game
 Play game ( have fun optional but ideal ːsteamthumbsupː  )
 Write review
 Tell friends about it
[/olist]

Thank you for playing and providing your feedback! 
Convento Dev

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Convento is now available in Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863154/3917e4e6e3bd306f81695bf8b58f2010bb6bef53.png

Dive in and get to know the characters and the story. But I'm not done yet, all future episodes will be released for free! And wait, there's more. Hold on, actually no, that's it for now.

Please use the Bugs, Issues and Support Board to report any problems you may find.


Future episodes will be announced and released as soon as possible.

Hope you'll enjoy Convento!
